subject: derefTargetBeforeRHS
column8: Stage E5 E5d (2026-09-22): `*p, p = derefTargetRHS(&p, &b), p` with derefTargetRHS redirecting p (&a -> &b) through its `&p` argument and returning 8 — the address `&p` is an argument (no occurrence); the dereference target's pointer operand and the right-hand read of p are each spec-unsequenced against the call (spec#Assignment_statements: the operands on the left and the expressions on the right are «evaluated in the usual order»): target read before / after the call x p read before / after — {828, 822, 181, 188}; gc 188 (both after the call — call-first, 20/20 under GOMAXPROCS 1/8, default and -N -l), the former strict pin of gc's order now ONE member; the ONE consumption site is the `unseq` scheduler's pick (`unseqNext`, bound = the ready-set size at each pick; design docs/2026-09-22_unseq-stage-e5-design.md §E5d). members=4
